$comment: The one list of repositories that make up the AI Video Production ecosystem, and who owns what. install.sh / scripts/bootstrap.sh install what is listed here ("optional": true only with --with-optional, "status": "planned" not at all), docs/ecosystem/registry.json must name the same non-planned repositories, and no two components may own the same thing (scripts/tests/test_ecosystem_manifest.py). The org charts in docs/ecosystem/org/ are generated from this file (scripts/orgchart.mjs). To add a Skill, add it here.
